children: The Indian central bank announced another cash withdrawal operation on Monday after technical glitches at a longer-term auction depressed participation, five traders said.

The Reserve Bank of India will conduct an overnight variable rate reverse repo (VRRR) for 5 trillion rupees ($52.96 billion), after receiving offers for 2.59 trillion rupees for a 30-day auction that provided banks an early redemption option.

"The bidding for the VRRR was changed to another platform, as E-Kuber, the usual one, had some technical issues, and hence some banks were caught unaware and were not able to participate," a trader with a state-run bank said.

title: India RBI announces overnight cash withdrawal after 'technical glitch' at 30-day auction
